environment.storage: Local NVMe for all biological inputs, reference, outputs and scratch

method: MSK 30-KO ES P02 was rerun with the corrected STAR Suite 1.9.5 source using the accepted benchmark build recipe. The three-library gene-expression, PolyIII CRISPR and LARRY command and configuration were preserved, including native gzip, GeneFull only, no BAM and no opt-in dominant LARRY caller. All reference files matched the accepted index checksums and were verified on NVMe. The run was serialized on a quiet host with the page cache dropped first. Whole-wrapper wall time includes reference loading and is measured by GNU time. Fresh canonical parity uses minimum 20 counts and detection in 1 percent of shared cells; paper gene correlations use all shared genes. Existing Cell Ranger 9.0.1 outputs and summed two-run timing are retained.

evidence.validation: Passed wrapper completion, matching timing boundary and all 22 required parity/concordance gates

limitations: This scoped correction supersedes the MSK row only; the A375 row in the previous record remains its accepted measurement.
One timed execution, not a replicated distribution. Other local and cloud arms were not rerun in this scoped session.
The separate dominant-LARRY release-acceptance run is output-validation evidence and is not used for paper timing.
Cell Ranger outputs are a comparator, not ground truth.
